'''Caille''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was among the casualties during the invasion of the [[Imperial Headquarters (Balmorra)|Imperial Headquarters]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Caille appears as a named enemy in the Imperial Headquarters, a location in the Republic version of Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
